title: WebFixBench model review response (v0.1)
description: The JSON object a reviewer must return. An empty findings list is valid and is the expected answer for a clean change. Output that does not validate is recorded as malformed and is never scored as correct.

overall_confidence.description: The reviewer's confidence in the review as a whole.

category.description: Free text; normalised onto the v0.1 taxonomy through the alias table in src/webfixbench/schemas.py. Unmapped values are counted as false positives, not dropped.

defect_type.description: Mechanism from the allowed v0.1 set. Unknown strings remain valid input but are counted as false positives.
